title: Glyph + DINOv3: smartphone skin-lesion diagnosis

metadata.scope: PAD-UFES-20: 1,373 patients, one original photograph each, seven diagnostic outcomes
metadata.notes: Patient-held-out diagnostic benchmark, not prognosis or external validation. The clinical baseline refits eight published inputs; it is not the historical fitted classifier. Some non-cancer labels use clinical consensus. Melanoma has only five test examples. Automated interpretation and confounder adjustment were not run. Images: Pacheco et al., PAD-UFES-20 v1, doi:10.17632/zr7vgbcyr2.1, CC BY 4.0; resized for display.

manifest.glyph_selection_rule: All 8192 dictionary columns fixed before extraction or evaluation; constant predictors do not affect the fit. Capped variants ranked using training-only two-sided logistic score tests.
caveats: Eight clinical fields encoded as 22 numerical predictors; top-ten arms rank encoded predictors.
Clinical coefficients are fitted on the new training split, not copied from a published classifier.
Contemporaneous diagnosis rather than prognosis; no external validation.
Clinical and histological reference standards differ among non-cancer cases.
No automated semantic interpretation or confounder adjustment.

bootstrap.method: Paired patient-cluster bootstrap; fixed fitted predictions; conditional on both classes
